title: NPC Pawnshop
body:
Builder: MSET <mob vnum> SHOPKEEPER ON then MSET <mob vnum> SHOPTYPE PAWNSHOP.

SELL <item> or SELL ALL <item> pawns any valuable, transferable item for the general-store selling price. The pawnshop actually keeps each individual copy, including worn tool durability. LIST displays its saved stock. BUY <item> or BUY ALL <item> purchases listed copies at 150% of the amount the pawnshop paid; a seller can buy back the same item, and other players can buy it too. Inventory persists through reboots, per shopkeeper and room.

Soulbound/mission/glued items, items declared worthless by a builder, and backpacks holding contents are not accepted. The anti-alt forged-item transfer protection, level limits, inventory capacity and shop hours continue to apply. Ordinary NPC store stock is not affected.
